items.raw_excerpt: Tickets for Infinity Vision-certified screenings for the upcoming blockbuster Avengers: Doomsday are now on sale.
items.summary_en: Tickets for Avengers: Doomsday are now on sale in Singapore. The movie is a big Hollywood action film. Fans can pay more to watch it in the special Infinity Vision format.
items.summary_ko: 어벤저스 신작의 티켓이 싱가포르에서 판매를 시작했다. 이 영화는 할리우드 액션 블록버스터다. 팬들은 더 비싼 가격을 내고 특별한 방식으로 상영되는 편도 볼 수도 있다.
items.title_en: Avengers: Doomsday tickets now on sale in Singapore

items.title_original: Avengers: Doomsday tickets now available for purchase in Singapore

items.raw_excerpt: Có một Đà Nẵng rất khác, không ồn ào bởi những đại lộ, những cây cầu hay những tòa nhà cao tầng. Đó là Đà Nẵng của núi đá, hang động, chùa cổ, những vách đá rêu phong và tiếng đục lách cách vọng ra từ các xưởng nghề. Đi về phía Ngũ Hành Sơn, người ta như bước qua một cánh cửa khác của thành phố - nơi đá không còn là vật chất vô tri mà trở thành ký ức, tín ngưỡng, nghệ thuật, văn hoá và sinh kế của bao thế hệ.
items.source_name: Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp & Kinh tế xanh
items.summary_en: Da Nang is known for busy avenues, bridges, and tall buildings. But in Ngũ Hành Sơn there is another side of the city, made of stone, caves, old pagodas, and mossy cliffs. Local craft villages here have turned marble into food, art, and memory for many families.
items.summary_ko: 다낭은 큰길과 다리, 높은 빌딩으로 익숙한 도시다. 하지만 응응선 산에는 동굴과 오래된 사원, 이끼 낀 바위 절벽으로 이루어진 다낭의 또 다른 모습이 있다. 지역의 대리석 장인들은 이 돌을 음식과 예술, 그리고 여러 세대의 기억으로 만들어냈다.
items.title_en: The Marble World Inside Da Nang
items.title_ko: 다낭의 대리석 세계
items.title_original: Lạc vào thế giới đá ở thành phố “đáng sống” Đà Nẵng - Tạp chí Doanh nghiệp & Kinh tế xanh

items.raw_excerpt: Sandon Smith's two tries in the NRL preliminary final didn't just win Newcastle the game, it earned the Knights halfback a share of history alongside the club's greatest ever player.
items.summary_en: Sandon Smith scored two tries in the NRL preliminary final to help Newcastle Knights win. His play also put him in the same history as club great Andrew Johns.
items.summary_ko: 샌던 스미스가 NRL 결승전에서 두 번의 트라이를 성공하며 뉴캐슬 나이츠의 승리를 이끌었다. 그의 플레이는 팀의 레전드 앤드루 존스와 함께 역사에 이름을 남겼다.
items.title_en: Sandon Smith leads Newcastle past a legend's shadow
items.title_ko: 샌던 스미스, 뉴캐슬을 전설의 그림자에서 빠져나오게 하다
items.title_original: Sandon Smith leads Newcastle out of an Immortal shadow

items.raw_excerpt: A seal pup caught crossing a busy Wellington street over the weekend received a police escort back to the water.
items.summary_en: A seal pup was found crossing a busy street in Wellington. Police helped it safely get back to the water. The young seal is now free.
items.summary_ko: 웰링턴의 번잡은 도로를 건너던 물범 새끼가 발견됐습니다. 경찰이 안전하게 물가로 데려다 주었습니다. 새끼 물범은 이제 자유롭게 헤엄치며 지냅니다.
items.title_en: Seal pup that crossed a busy Wellington road gets a police escort back to the sea

items.raw_excerpt: Several sharks are spotted circling in the area after local surf lifesavers found the whale carcass this morning.
items.summary_en: Surf lifesavers found a whale carcass on City Beach this morning. Several sharks have been spotted circling in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: The programme allows customers to see the price per unit of measurement of a product, making it easier to compare value across different product sizes and brands.
items.summary_en: More supermarkets in Singapore will show the price per unit from October 1. This will help shoppers compare prices between different sizes and brands.

items.raw_excerpt: Con un masivo desfile naval visible desde el borde costero de Viña del Mar y Valparaíso, la Armada de Chile celebró este domingo el retorno de las unidades de la Fuerza Anfibia, tras cumplir casi dos meses de despliegue en el Teatro de Operaciones Conjunto Austral en el marco de la operación OPS-B. El evento congregó a cientos de familias en la avenida Perú y los miradores de la bahía para presenciar la recalada de los buques, luego de que la institución desarrollara complejas maniobras navales
items.summary_en: Chile's navy held a large naval parade in the bay of Valparaiso on Sunday. Sailors and families watched from the shore. The ships had just returned from about two months of duty near the country's far south.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 해군이 일요일 발파라이소 만에서 대규모 함식을 열었습니다. 소대와 가족들이 해안에서 관람했습니다. 참가 함선들은 약 두 달간 임무 끝에 귀환한 상태였습니다.
items.title_en: Chile Navy shows its strength in a big naval parade

items.title_original: Escuadra Nacional lució sus capacidades con desfile naval

items.raw_excerpt: The ACT government says it will remain the only jurisdiction without anti-consorting legislation, despite warnings weaker laws are making the territory a "safe haven" for outlaw motorcycle gangs.
items.summary_en: The ACT government will not pass laws that ban people from meeting with criminal groups. Police and lawyers warn that weak rules make the territory a safe place for outlaw motorcycle clubs. ACT would be the only Australian state or territory without such laws.
items.summary_ko: 캔버라주 정부는 범죄 조직 구성원들이 모여 있는 것을 막는 법안을 거부했다. 경찰과 변호사들은 법이 느슨해 캔버라주가 반법 오토바이 무리의 안전한 피난처가 되고 있다고 우려한다. 그렇게면 캔버라주가 이런 법이 없는 유일한 지역이 된다.
items.title_en: ACT rejects laws against gang meetings
items.title_ko: 캔버라주, 조직 범죄 관련 법안 거부
items.title_original: Anti-consorting laws rejected by ACT amid fears it's a bikie 'safe haven'

items.raw_excerpt: The Central Weather Administration (CWA) issued heat advisories for eight municipalities across Taiwan on Monday, warning that temperatures may exceed 36 degrees Celsius around noon.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's weather office issued heat warnings for eight cities and towns on Monday. People in those areas may see temperatures above 36 degrees Celsius at noon. The advice is to drink water and stay out of the sun.
items.summary_ko: 대기현상단은 월요일에 대만 8개 시·군에 폭염 특보를 발령했다. 해당 지역에는 낮12시를 중심으로 기온이 36도를 넘을 수 있다고 밝혔다. 물을 자주 마시고 햇볕을 피하라고/eplainedExtreme advice.

items.raw_excerpt: Public initiatives suffer a major setback at the ballot box; Swiss government allocates 334.5 million francs for the integration of foreigners; and more news in our roundup on Monday.
items.summary_en: Swiss voters rejected some public plans in a vote this week. The government will spend 334.5 million francs to help newcomers settle in the country. Here is a quick look at other news from Monday.
items.summary_ko: 스위스 유권자들이 week's 투표에서 일부 공공 계획을 부결했다. 정부는 이민자들의 정착을 돕기 위해 3억 3450만 프랑을 배정했다. 월요일에 나온 주요 뉴스들을 간단히 정리했다.

items.summary_en: A roundup of news from Austria on Monday. Lawmakers debated stronger rules for religion classes in schools. The SPÖ party also faces a new problem about its leadership.

items.raw_excerpt: Bogong moths might be endangered, but there have been hundreds of sightings reported across NSW in recent days as they migrate to the Snowy Mountains.
items.summary_en: Millions of bogong moths are moving south through the Australian mountains. Many homes in New South Wales are covered by the moths at night. The moths are flying to the Snowy Mountains for the season.
items.summary_ko: 매미방울나방이 호주 산악지대를 따라 남쪽으로 날아가고 있다. 뉴사우스웨일스에서는 밤마다 수백만 마리가 집안을 뒤덮고 있다. 이 나방들은 이번 계절을 위해 스노우 산으로 향하고 있다.

items.title_ko: 수백만 매미방울나방이 집을 침범

items.raw_excerpt: There are not enough clinicians at Dannevirke Community Hospital to ensure patients will receive safe care, an urgent audit has found.
items.summary_en: An urgent audit says Dannevirke Community Hospital in New Zealand does not have enough clinicians. The hospital cannot provide safe and sustainable care to patients who stay overnight. The health board must now decide how to fix the problem.

items.raw_excerpt: CADC to implement NEP from 2027-28 and introduce weekly Mizo Speaking Day (Wednesdays) in primary/middle schools, plus literacy drive and Fridays’ Anapana meditation.
items.summary_en: The Chakma council in Mizoram will follow the national school policy from 2027. It also wants every Wednesday to be a Mizo Speaking Day in primary and middle schools. A literacy drive and Friday meditation are planned too.

items.summary_en: An Indian space startup called TakeMe2Space will send its first small satellite into orbit on October 1. The satellite will do computing work in space instead of sending raw data back to Earth. It will ride on a SpaceX rocket launched from Bengaluru.

items.summary_en: The Madras High Court has refused to review its earlier order about labels for micro and nano plastics. The rule applies to bottled water, sugar and salt. The court said it wants to keep customers informed about what is in these products.
